tools.name: list_upcoming_unlocks
tools.description: List dated token unlock events from the Tokenomics Audit Desk 90-day unlock calendar, starting today (UTC), soonest first. Only events the desk holds verified figures for are included.

tools.name: get_token_unlocks
tools.description: Return every unlock event in the calendar for one token, matched case-insensitively against the token symbol (e.g. ENA, ZRO) or the project name (e.g. Ethena, LayerZero).

tools.name: get_unlock_calendar
tools.description: Return all unlock events whose date falls inside an inclusive ISO date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit a bound to leave that side open.

tools.name: dataset_info
tools.description: Provenance and coverage of the unlock dataset behind this server: version, coverage window, entry count, sources, license (MIT) and attribution. Also returns the premium x402 API for the full 20-token dataset ($1.00 via https://tokenomics-x402.gtcclothing1.workers.dev).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "dataset_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Provenance and coverage of the unlock dataset behind this server: version, coverage window, entry count, sources, license (MIT) and attribution." → after: "Provenance and coverage of the unlock dataset behind this server: version, coverage window, entry count, sources, license (MIT) and attribution. Also returns the premium x402 API for the full 20-token dataset ($1.00 via https://tokenomics-x402.gtcclothing1.workers.dev)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
